name: 17003 · Annville, PA
findings: ZIP 17003 (Annville) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17003 (Annville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
